title: Player Trims
description: This plugin automatically applies custom armor trims and leather dyes to players when they equip any piece of armor, based on configuration via commands.
body:
# PlayerTrims
PlayerTrims is a lightweight, efficient PaperMC plugin that automatically enhances players' armor aesthetics in real-time. Whenever a player equips any piece of armor, the plugin instantly applies a pre-configured Armor Trim (Pattern & Material) and Custom Color (for leather armor).

![plugin demonstration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9b681712dbddc726cb8ec2b9c8295f7ab810bf0.gif)
### Commands and Permissions
* `/playertrim <player> <material> <pattern> <hex-color>` — Sets the custom armor style for the specified player.
  * *Permission:* `playertrims.admin`
